source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Whenever this unit finishes a **Charge move**, pick one enemy unit in **Engagement Range** of it and roll a D6 for every model in this unit; each 4+ inflicts D3 **mortal wounds** on that enemy unit.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
